zen.text: Kiora arrives at Sea Gate on an enormous octopus tentacle, claiming command of her own army, and when she summons a wave her sea creatures tear into the Eldrazi.

When Jori En warns that Ulamog is coming, Kiora argues for an assault rather than evacuation, and Gideon sends her to coordinate a sea attack, though she insists on attacking with the bident rather than joining Jace's hedron trap.

She takes her own army into open water and wakes Lorthos, but Kozilek rises from the bay, kills Shen through her own hand and cleaves Lorthos in two, and Kiora realizes she has been tricked and loses consciousness.

Jori finds her with a broken leg and helps her recover the bident, which she uses to flood the caves, but at the end, when Nissa binds the titans, Kiora argues that Zendikar will die with them, empties the Halimar Sea at Nissa, and leaves with the bident.

bfz.text: Kiora lands on Zendikar still clutching a bident stolen from a god on another world, and finds Eldrazi dust across a beach and dead places in the sea.
She uses the bident and sea creatures to drive Eldrazi off a hundred merfolk refugees and reunites with her sister Turi, who tells her Ulamog is at Sea Gate.
Kiora promises Turi she will return and heads for Sea Gate with devotees of Cosi, and when Yenai's group refuses to go back there, she takes a few recruits and swims off.
She arrives at the Liberation of Sea Gate with merfolk and sea monster reinforcements, meets Gideon, and they retake the city together.

ogw.text: As the titans head to Halimar Basin, Kiora joins the Sea Gate survivors, and Jace plans to kill Kozilek and Ulamog by binding them to Zendikar with a leyline pattern.
Kiora then urges releasing the titans and betrays the group by lifting the Halimar Sea to hurl at Nissa, though Jace deflects it onto the Eldrazi spawn.
Chandra burns the titans through Nissa's ley lines, and Kiora walks away alone from the battlefield.
